description.zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID，可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query the ID.

description.zh:
设备IotId列表。支持传入V系列边缘一体机或摄像机的IotId。

IotId是物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

单次最多可填写20个设备IotId。
description.en:
The list of device IotIds. You can specify the IotIds of V-series edge servers or cameras.

An IotId is the unique identifier that IoT Platform assigns to a device.
You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) in IoT Platform to query the IotId.

You can specify up to 20 device IotIds in a single request.

description.zh:
实例ID。

- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

- Enterprise Edition instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of the Enterprise Edition instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter.

title.zh: 将图片搜索应用程序与设备绑定
title.en: Bind a picture search application with devices

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制
如果在企业版实例中调用该接口，请求参数**IotInstanceId**必须填写。否则，调用接口会失败。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
If you call this operation in an Enterprise Edition instance, the **IotInstanceId** request parameter is required. Otherwise, the call fails.
